summary: Verified the newly added /contact page and header CTA change. Backend pytest suite (6/6 passing) extended to assert the new optional 'subject' field on POST /api/contact request/response and on GET list persistence. Frontend Playwright verified: (1) Header nav-cta label is 'Contact' and navigates to /contact (URL change, dedicated page renders) rather than scrolling. (2) /contact renders eyebrow CONTACT, heading 'Get in Touch', contactpage-email-link, and contactpage-form. (3) Client-side validation with noValidate works: empty submit shows contactpage-error-name/email/message; name '12345' and '@@@' rejected; email 'notanemail' rejected; mobile 'abc123' rejected; message <10 chars and whitespace-only rejected. (4) Valid submission (Jane Doe, jane@example.com, +91 98765 43210, subject, 'I would love to discuss your research approach.') disables submit button immediately (verified via evaluate: b.disabled=true right after click) and shows contactpage-success panel. (5) Persistence confirmed via GET /api/contact — subject field included and phone stored as sent. (6) Footer footer-contact-cta routes to /contact and footer-email-link present; no duplicate contactpage-form on homepage. (7) From /contact, clicking nav-portfolio navigates to '/' (SPA route change, lenis scrolls to section).
critical_code_review_comments: ContactPage.jsx submit handler is idempotent (early-return if loading) and disables the submit button while in-flight — good.
server.py POST /api/contact stores subject and returns it; GET excludes _id. Pydantic EmailStr enforces 422 for invalid email. Whitespace-only name/message correctly returns 400.
email_service.send_lead_emails is dispatched via BackgroundTasks; when RESEND_API_KEY is empty it is a safe no-op — verified API still returns 200 (documented as expected in preview).
Minor: /api/contact list endpoint returns up to 1000 with no pagination — acceptable for current scale but flag for future.
Minor: CORS uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' (carried over from previous review) — non-blocking for this public site.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Persist_* and prior TEST_ contact messages via API/UI. Filterable by 'TEST_' prefix in subject/name.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression: /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (pytest, 6/6). New subject field asserted in create/persistence test. Frontend: nav-cta -> /contact (not scroll). Full validation coverage on ContactPage. Footer footer-contact-cta is a Link to /contact; homepage has no contactpage-form. Section nav links from /contact use navigate('/') + setTimeout scroll (~500ms) — allow ~1s wait when asserting return-home behavior.
